name: satisfactory-dash
description: Dashboard + backend for a live Satisfactory dedicated server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared --if-present && npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w agent && npm run build -w server-manager
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w packages/game-adapter && npm run lint -w frontend && npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w agent && npm run lint -w server-manager
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w packages/game-adapter && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w agent && npm run typecheck -w server-manager
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/game-adapter && npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w agent && npm run test -w server-manager && npm run test:scripts
scripts.test:scripts: node --test scripts/architecture-drift.test.mjs scripts/ci-select.test.mjs scripts/log.test.mjs scripts/log-check.test.mjs scripts/latency-report.test.mjs scripts/e2e-report.test.mjs scripts/preflight.test.mjs scripts/delivery-metrics.test.mjs scripts/tls-floor.test.mjs scripts/migration-contract-check.test.mjs scripts/deploy/deploy.test.mjs scripts/backup-check.test.mjs scripts/restore-check.test.mjs scripts/dev/lib.test.mjs scripts/raw-source-citations.test.mjs scripts/lint/safe-lookup.test.mjs load/test/guards.test.mjs load/test/plan.test.mjs load/test/seed.test.mjs load/test/report.test.mjs load/test/boundaries.test.mjs
